preparation_intent_argument.description: Declare what remains of the exact current player request after this preparation succeeds. Use unresolved_action if an attack or other action was declared and still needs resolution; omission has that same meaning. Use await_player_choice only when the request ends at preparation, such as establishing Initiative before the player chooses an action. Never use it to abandon an already-declared action or invent the player's next choice. This is provider-only control, not a Ruleset or Campaign State field.

text.description: Scene description, actions and speech attribution. Keep NPC spoken words in separate npc_utterance blocks.

speaker_id.description: Exact current Campaign Entity or visible non-player participant ID, or an entity_id this same update records in entities. Record a named NPC as an entity and use its ID. Use anonymous only for a speaker without an ID.

speaker_name.description: With speaker_id anonymous: the name or short description the player knows this speaker by, as the narration calls them. It labels the speech box.

spoken_words.description: Only the words this NPC says aloud, without enclosing quotation marks. No actions, gestures, speaker names or 'she says' attribution. End this utterance when narration interrupts, then resume speech in a new npc_utterance block, even for the same speaker.

campaign_file_revised_narration_argument.description: One complete ordered response. Put scene prose in narration blocks, each NPC's spoken words only in npc_utterance.spoken_words, and any OOC reply in a separate ooc block. NPC dialogue uses an exact current Campaign Entity or visible non-player participant speaker_id, an entity_id this same update records, or the anonymous sentinel with a speaker_name. Use one narration block for a response without dialogue. Sylvia holds the response until this Campaign File disposition succeeds. The collections and response must describe the same post-action truth. If an earlier response is already held, return its complete corrected replacement or an exact copy when it is already right; never return an edit note.

function.name: read_tool_arguments
function.description: READ-ONLY: return the exact inputs one choice of a tool accepts, for a tool whose schema keeps them in one object field (for example a spell's own casting inputs). Call it before using that choice for the first time in this conversation.

value.description: The selected choice, for example the spell.
